title: Export stuck or taking too long
resolution: Retry the export, confirm the project loads correctly, and test another browser or session before escalating.

title: Unable to sign in
resolution: Confirm the email address, retry sign-in, and use the password-reset flow if needed.

title: Duo Mobile authentication issue
resolution: Confirm the user can access their enrolled device and retry the authentication flow. If the user lost or replaced the device, cannot receive Duo pushes, has an expired enrollment link, or remains locked out, escalate to an authorized support agent for account-specific MFA recovery.

title: Subscription charge questions
resolution: Confirm the subscription plan and transaction details, then route account-specific billing disputes to a human agent.

title: Slow or unresponsive workspace
resolution: Refresh the session, close unused browser tabs, and test another supported browser before escalating persistent performance issues.

title: Reporting a product bug
resolution: Collect reproduction steps, browser information, expected behavior, and any visible error message before escalation.

title: Account security concern
resolution: Escalate the ticket to a human immediately and avoid making account-specific changes through an automated flow.
